prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Chicago for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your needs. For a dental implant you want a clinician with the right training, experience, and a good restorative team — not just the highest-rated clinic. I can help find a dentist, but first here’s how to choose and some questions so I can give a tailored recommendation.

What to look for
- Specialty and training: for placing implants, look for a board-certified oral and maxillofacial surgeon, periodontist, or a prosthodontist (for complex restorations). Many general dentists also place implants — check their training and case experience.
- Experience and volume: ask how many implants they place per year and their success/complication rates.
- Restorative coordination: ideal care involves a team approach (surgeon/periodontist + restorative dentist or prosthodontist) so the crown fits and functions long-term.
- Technology: in-office CBCT (3D imaging), guided surgery/digital planning, and good implant systems/manufacturer support improve predictability.
- Before/after cases and references: ask to see photos of similar cases and patient testimonials.
- Sedation and comfort options: if anxious, check sedation (oral, IV) availability and safety protocols.
- Warranties/guarantees and fee transparency: ask what’s included, timelines, and contingency for implant failure.
- Insurance/cost and financing: implants vary widely in price; find out total cost (surgery + crown + any bone grafts).

Where to search and verify
- Professional directories: American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID) locator, American Academy of Periodontology, American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons.
- Local academic centers: University of Illinois at Chicago (UIC) College of Dentistry may have specialists or referrals.
- Patient review sites: Google, Yelp, Healthgrades, Zocdoc — use reviews but confirm credentials independently.
- Ask your general dentist for referrals and to be involved in the restorative plan.

Would you like me to:
- Find top-rated implant specialists in a particular Chicago neighborhood?
- Compare a few specific dentists or practices you already have in mind?
- Provide a checklist of questions to ask during a consultation?

Tell me your location/neighborhood, whether you prefer a specialist type (oral surgeon/periodontist/prosthodontist), and if insurance or budget matters, and I’ll pull a short, specific list you can contact.
